releaseTitle: ATalk v3.5.5 — Streamlined Navigation, Ephemeral Auto-Destruct & Chat Actions
releaseNotes:
• 01 Bottom Bar Streamline: Removed Settings button from the bottom floating capsule dock, creating a clean 3-tab layout (Chats, Updates, Calls).
• 02 Chat List Cleanup: Removed pencil FAB from the bottom-right corner of the chat list screen.
• 03 Chat Actions Relocation: Added 'Clear Chat' directly into the top-right More options dropdown menu with full dual-scope deletion ('Delete for Everyone' / 'Delete for Me') and removed it from the Contact Info sheet.
• 04 Disappearing Messages Overhaul: Complete UI upgrade featuring tactical duration tiles (Off, 30s, 5m, 1h, 24h, 7d, 90d), burning live bubble preview, and volatile RAM hygiene certification.
• 05 Real-Time Ephemeral Auto-Pruning: Accurate expiresAt timestamps, persistent per-conversation disappearing timers, real-time background countdown badges (e.g. 🔥 24h, 🔥 25s), and auto-purging of expired messages from cache and UI.
